title: Dissociative Anesthetics (PCP, Ketamine)
citation: DEA, Drugs of Abuse: A DEA Resource Guide (2024 ed.), pp. 79, 83
key_points: Signs (ketamine): feeling detached or out of control, distorted sight and sound, rapid eye movement, dilated pupils, drooling, tearing, muscle stiffness, possible unresponsiveness.
Severe overdose (PCP or ketamine): breathing depression, seizures, coma, death from respiratory arrest.
officer_notes: Watch breathing closely for anyone who becomes unresponsive.
